versions.text: Criterion: Verify that departure from controlled flight characteristics is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within the following MIL-STD-1797 paragraphs: a. 5.2.5.5 Departure from controlled flight. b. 5.2.5.5.1 Departure warning. c. 5.2.5.5.2 Uncommanded motions. d. 5.2.5.5.3 Departure avoidance following sudden asymmetric loss of thrust. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.
